integrity: The general proof uses Haar equidistribution, signed-incidence cancellation, and a unimodular forest coordinate change. The supplementary checker verifies representative nontrivial cumulant identities and the finite-size prefactor but is not used as a substitute for the proof. Prior work's general XY mapping and model-specific independent-sum CLT are explicitly treated as prior input.
scientific_limitations: The relative one-particle gaps are assumed rationally independent; resonant spectra can add further temporal cumulant terms.
The finite-size Berry–Esseen bound is proved for forest active support only; cyclic supports are covered only by the exact low-order cumulant formulas.
The theorem is for number-conserving quasifree fermions and quadratic observables; pairing Hamiltonians are not included without a separate doubled-space derivation.
title: Cycle-controlled temporal cumulants and a forest Berry–Esseen theorem for quasifree fermions
